boundary_handling.rationale: BKT-F guess estimates at the optimizer upper boundary have unreliable local-Hessian standard errors. They are excluded from hyperparameter estimation and down-weighted during shrinkage. This is a benchmark calibration rule, not a claim of a standard universal EB procedure.

item_calibration.holdout: difficulty-stratified deterministic 20 percent by item identity within skill
item_calibration.item_prior_variance: interaction-weighted variance of raw shifts minus interaction-weighted mean squared item-shift standard error

method: normal-normal empirical-Bayes shrinkage; REML hyperparameters on transformed scale; boundary-adjacent guess fits excluded from hyperparameter estimation and assigned a pre-specified transformed-SE floor during shrinkage
